max_object_bytes.description: Largest response body stored. Null means 16 MiB.

memory_max_bytes.description: Share of the server's memory store. Null uses the default (256 MiB in total).

summary.description: Non-secret description such as the chat id or webhook host.

ComponentStatus.description: Agent and cache versions per server.

queued.description: Agents and caches queued for an update.

engine.description: postgres, mysql, mariadb, mongo, or redis.

public_port.description: Publish the database port on the host. Omit to keep it internal.

start.description: Start the container right away. Defaults to true.

compose_service.description: Required for compose stacks unless the stack has a main service.

build_on_deploy.description: Deploy also builds images that have a `build:` section. Defaults to false.

deploy_on_push.description: A push to the Git branch deploys the stack. Defaults to false.

main_service.description: Compose service new domains point at by default.

start.description: Run `docker compose up` right away. Defaults to false.
Run `docker compose up` right away. Defaults to true.

logs.description: The end of the log (at most 200 000 characters); see `logs_truncated`.

logs_truncated.description:
The log is longer than `logs`; the whole text is at
`/api/v1/services/{id}/deployments/{deployment}/logs`.

access_key_hint.description: Last four characters of the access key id.

compose_service.description: Compose service inside a stack that receives the traffic.

csr_pem.description: PKCS#10 request for the agent's own key, PEM.

grpc_url.description: Where the agent dials its gRPC session.

tls_name.description: TLS server name to verify on that connection.

account.description: GitHub account that installed the app.

app_slug.description: Slug of a GitHub App created from the panel.

status.description: `ready`, or `pending_install` for a GitHub App that is not installed yet.

install_url.description: Send the browser here to install the new app.

state.description: From the install link. Without it, the panel looks for the pending app the installation belongs to.

action_url.description: Where the browser POSTs the manifest. It already carries the `state`.

manifest.description: The manifest as JSON text, for a form field named `manifest`.

webhook.description: False when the panel's address is private, so GitHub cannot deliver pushes.

level.description: Detected from the message when omitted.

service_id.description: The project is filled in from the service.

timestamp.description: Defaults to now. Must be within the last 30 days.

next_before_time.description: Pass as `before_time` and `before_id` to fetch older lines.

m1_days.description: Days to keep each rollup resolution, 1 to 365.

include_history.description: Also include log lines, metric samples, and sessions.

passphrase.description: At least 12 characters. Needed to restore; it is not stored.

target_path.description: Host path for bind and path backups. Defaults to the original path.

target_service_id.description: Database or service to restore into. Defaults to the job's service.

target_volume.description: Volume name for volume backups. Defaults to the original volume.

log_days.description: Days to keep per log source.

bypass_cookies.description: Requests carrying a cookie whose name starts with one of these skip the cache.

ignore_query.description: Drop the query string from the cache key.

query_keys.description: When non-empty, only these query parameters are part of the key (sorted).

respect_origin.description: Use `s-maxage`/`max-age` from the origin when present, and honor `no-store`/`private`.

statuses.description: Response statuses that may be stored.

ttl_secs.description: Freshness when the origin gives none, or always when `respect_origin` is false.

RuleMatch.description: Every set field must match. An empty matcher matches every request.

extensions.description: File extensions without the dot, compared case-insensitively.

path_glob.description: `*` matches any run of characters; anchored at both ends.

path_prefixes.description: Path must start with one of these.

encryption_passphrase.description: Client-side encryption passphrase. Empty string removes encryption.

schedule_cron.description: Five-field cron or a preset such as `@daily`. Empty string clears it.

preset.description: Preset slug to start from when creating.

rules.description: Ordered rules; the first match wins. Defaults to the preset's rules on create.

config.description:
`{"kind":"telegram","bot_token","chat_id"}`, `{"kind":"discord"|"slack","webhook_url"}`,
`{"kind":"webhook","url","secret"?}`, or
`{"kind":"smtp","host","port"?,"security":"starttls"|"tls"|"none","username"?,"password"?,"from","to":[]}`.
On update, empty secret fields keep the stored value.

auto_prune.description: Remove dangling images and build cache once a day.

enrolled_at.description: When the agent last exchanged a join token for a certificate.

telemetry_dropped.description: Telemetry items the agent discarded because its buffer was full.

domain_id.description: Limit the purge to one domain. Defaults to every cached domain of the service.

stats.description: Counters for this service's cached hosts.

stats_error.description: Why stats are missing, such as an unreachable cache server.

compose_file.description: Path of the compose file inside the repository.

build.description: Built from a `build:` section, so a plain deploy does not pick up new code.

running.description: Null when the server cannot be reached.

has_default.description: The file gives a fallback (`${NAME:-x}`) everywhere it reads the variable.

required.description: The file refuses to start without it (`${NAME:?error}`).

set.description: A value is saved under Environment.

build_on_deploy.description: Deploy also builds images that have a `build:` section.

deploy_on_push.description: A push to the Git branch deploys the stack.

generated_yaml.description: The file Rudder runs: project name, labels, and proxy network applied.

missing_variables.description: Referenced variables with no value under Environment and no fallback in the file.

variable_details.description: Every variable the file reads, and whether it is set or has a fallback.

name.description: Name of the app. Defaults to `Rudder-` and four random characters.

organization.description: Create the app under this organization instead of your own account.

generated.description: Secrets generated for empty fields. Shown once; they are stored encrypted.

kind.description: domain, string, email, secret, number, or boolean.

oneOf.description: Newest release above the current version, if any.

pending.description:
Every release between the installed version and `latest`, oldest first,
`latest` included: what an update installs, with each release's notes.

verified.description: The latest release's signature and checksums were verified.

policy_id.description: Null uses the built-in "Honor origin headers" policy.

apply_blocker.description: Why "Update now" is unavailable, if it is.

maintenance_window.description: `HH:MM-HH:MM` in UTC; automatic updates wait for it. Empty means any time.

signing_key.description: A release signing key is configured, so verified releases can be applied.

target_cache_image.description: Cache image for this panel version, from its signed release.

log_days.description: Days to keep per source, 1 to 365. Sources not listed keep their value.

oneOf.description: Replaces the metric retention when present.

auto_prune.description: Prune dangling images and build cache once a day.

build_on_deploy.description: Deploy also builds images that have a `build:` section. Unchanged when omitted.

deploy_on_push.description: A push to the Git branch deploys the stack. Unchanged when omitted.

bearer.description: Scoped API token. Send `Authorization: Bearer rdr_...`.
